defects.quote: compute queue depth was near saturation
defects.why: The aggregates report an observed maximum of 251 but provide no queue capacity or saturation limit.

notes: Otherwise accurately preserves the verdict and gives appropriately cautious, verifiable actions.

defects.quote: No resource policy threshold was configured
defects.why: NO_POLICY does not establish that no policy was configured; it only establishes that no applicable SLA-effect rule produced a result for the window.

defects.quote: overall throughput ratio ... is lower than the window ratio
defects.why: It compares rates derived from raw numerator/denominator fields whose relationship and unit conversion are not defined by the evidence.

notes: The core verdict and diagnostic cautions are sound, but the policy-configured claim and unsupported rate comparison are misleading.

defects.quote: no resource policy existed to fail
defects.why: NO_POLICY does not prove that no resource policy was configured, only that no applicable SLA-effect rule yielded a resource result for the window.

notes: It is otherwise cautious about causality, scope differences, and the unavailable statistical support.

defects.why: The evidence provides raw throughput numerator and denominator plus a separate target rate, but does not define a supported derived achieved-throughput rate.

defects.quote: for most of the window after starting near 5
defects.why: Aggregate minimum and percentile values do not establish when the queue began low or its temporal progression through the window.

notes: The verdict and most recommended checks are correct, but it invents a queue timeline and an achieved-throughput relation.
